objective: Preserve the proven lean engine while activating higher-density reasoning only when its expected terminal-value gain exceeds its service and switching costs.

v0_7_series_lessons.v0.7.0: Opponent memory and productive-threat telemetry improved diagnosis, but adaptation alone did not create superiority.
v0_7_series_lessons.v0.7.1-i5: Dynamic reserves, sticky routes, reverse closeout, and bounded purchases form the promoted lean control.
v0_7_series_lessons.v0.7.2: Frontier expansion demonstrated a higher-cap mechanism but lost broadly when land, livestock, and labor density were activated universally.

training_plan: Run identical seeds through lean, selective-expansion, and frontier policies; label the best risk-adjusted terminal outcome; fit shallow splits offline; compile thresholds and leaf values into the submission agent.
promotion_gates: Preserve the full v0.7.1-i5 predecessor gate.
No opponent persona family may remain below a 50 percent win rate.
Positive aggregate margin on held-out seeds and both seats.
At least one reproducible 60,000-plus terminal-bank trajectory.
Zero runtime failures or suspicious fallbacks; every action below 700 ms.
